maddeler.e:
أختصر (form VIII)
# أَخْتَصِرُ (ʔaḵtaṣiru) /ʔax.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# أُخْتَصَرُ (ʔuḵtaṣaru) /ʔux.ta.sˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# أَخْتَصِرَ (ʔaḵtaṣira) /ʔax.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# أُخْتَصَرَ (ʔuḵtaṣara) /ʔux.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
